text: I'm sorry but this game is horrible! You don't even earn lives over a period of time. Unless you spend money, you have to log in every hour to collect 2K coins which isn't even enough to start a level! Once you advance a little bit, it costs more to start a level than the measly amount of coins you collect. Forget if you need extra cards. The premise is great, but it's just another pay to win game. Do better Disney!

This game starts out great but it becomes a disgusting cash grab after you have been playing for so long. So many times I get stuck on a level that doesn't even give me a legitimate way to win the level in order for you to spend your coins. It's an extremely scummy tactic knowing people will want to finish a level and spend money to do so.

Once you get past a certain point you have to buy the in game currency or you just won't win. I played the same level 7 times without buying a wildcard or the extra cards and lost every time. I even used over a dozen rewinds just to make sure I chose the best cards in the most efficient order. I'd have one or two cards left on the field and sometimes up to ten left in my draw pile but still couldn't beat the level without buying upgrades. It's all a scam!

I like the graphics and game itself, my problem is that there are no options to watch videos to gain coins or better side missions that offer more coins or free plays. After playing the game for a few months it's not worth it. The cost of each game keeps going up. Right now my level takes 5k coins and I receive between 6k-7k if I win. Most games like this allow you to receive the coins when you hit streaks. This one doesn't. Also the stars go up but you can only win 1 at a time.

Was roped into this game through my Earnin app. was offering double cash rewards for play. I thought it was progress based. I went as far as level 34 and was told to wait 24hrs to see any cash. I have yet to see a dime. lots of encouragement to spend my own real money. Why would I be trying to play a game for cash if I have cash to spend? So Dumb. And a huge scam and waste of time. I figured I'd see something after level 20. Asinine.

It's a Disney game - meaning OF COURSE there's going to be an insane amount of pay walls and pay to continue moments. that's literally their whole company... the first 50 levels feel fun and normal, but then you'll be set up with cards that do not match at all with a deck of cards that don't even allow you to start or move forward, forcing you to keep wasting coins on the level, or just straight up buying with real money to get through. the games mechanics switch A LOT.. every 10 levels or so.

Update: The cost of everything just keeps growing the farther you get. You will lose more and more games. I've just played the basic level, which are now $18000. Forget getting extra cards, they're twice the cost of a single play, hit $200000 for one game. You will go through multiple sets and get not one to help. Ad bonus stops helping. Any 3+ reviews here are likely app farming. This game doesn't function like it came from a multi-billion dollar corp. Worse than Disney MK app. Embarrassing.

I like this game! The card game is fun and the Disney scenes are cute. But there are coins in the game, and the way the game is set up, you slowly lose more coins than you earn. Then they keep trying to get you to pay real money for more coins. Lots of popups, $1.99 for 2 or 3 games worth of coins. They do gift free coins sometimes, but not much. I would rate the game 5 stars if there was a way to keep playing for free, and more coin rewards. I would be willing to watch ads to get more coins.

I liked this game at first. It was nice to play a game with no ads. I was lucky too- I won lots of levels without running out of coins. As soon as I decided to spend a few dollars though, the game became infinitely harder. Now I lose about 75% of the time, and I'm always out of coins. the only reason I haven't uninstalled it yet, is that I have several other games to turn to when I get shut out of this one. Now I wish it did have ads, so that there was an option to keep playing without $.

Great app but unfortunately like most apps focused on making money, once you reach the higher levels it's almost impossible to complete a board without the need to spend money. When you first start playing, the rewards allow you to play additional cards when you need them and give you enough coins to play another game. But as you progress in the game, it costs more and more coins to play a new game and now it costs more than 10k coins for me to get extra cards when I have one left to clear, 😭

For 2 days straight I've been stuck in a loop of pop ups in game. When I try to start a round, all of the pop ups for purchase start and I can never start a new game. It goes through all 5 or 6 of them, goes back to the start new game screen, and then all the pop ups come back again. I am able to play w couple rounds when I first open the app, but then this happens again.

The gameplay is fun and the visuals are delightful. If you take the time to log in every hour and build your coins up you could play entirely for free. That said the game is addictive and the bundles they sell to keep you going are predatory. I also do not like that this game interrupts my audio, even when I mute this games music and effects. And it keeps crashing, usually I can get back in right away, but today I've tried four times to open the game and it keeps crashing.

So the game is polished, looks good, etc, etc. The thing I'm wondering is if it purposely feeds you levels you can't win in order to (potentially) entice you to spend money? UPDATE. I've played a lot and determined 2 things, don't spend money. Just stop when you're done. Save coins throughout the day and play casually. Events always end, new ones start. You'll always fluctuate coins. I had 500k yesterday, played for hours, then lost it all in minutes. Don't drop real money unless you want to.

While fun to play, this game absolutely is pay-to-win. I went from 100,000 coins to not being able to play any game. You get down to one or two cards and seven or eight left in your deck, and yet NOT able to pull a card to finish the puzzle. Meanwhile, other puzzles will rifle off a ton of applicable cards in a row that somehow seem to match every card on the board. This game doesn't let you stay successful for very long, all in an attempt to get you to spend your money on bonuses. GREED.

The game is cute and fairly easy for the first two chapters. once you hit the third, you are consistently having to spend all your coins for either more cards or a wild card to complete levels. I'm able to do 1 sometimes 2 plays before I've used all my coins and have to wait for more. Now, you can then purchase coins through their many "Specials" going on if you don't want to wait. I do like that there are no ads, aside from their own pop-ups wanting you to purchase with real money.

Game is cute & fun. No ads. Love it. Originally downloaded it so my kid would improve with numbers. But you can't progress without spending REAL money. Never enough time to finish challenges without spending REAL money. I have put so much real money into this game, I refuse to do so anymore. To earn coins the free way takes forever, so I only get to play like once every 2 days. My son has lost interest in playing, he waits for me to earn enough stars or puzzle pieces so he can do that part.

This game becomes costly very quickly. Around level 25 the cost to play each level increases significantly as well as any aides. The same is true of the stars needed to get puzzle pieces. Not coincidentally, as the cost goes up the ability to pass levels gets difficult to pass without help; this occurs around level 30. There are far better options for Solitaire game play, but if you are a diehard Disney fan you will enjoy the cute and colorful graphics. I deleted around level 45.

I had to edit this review after playing awhile more. My biggest gripes with this game that actually makes so angry is the fact you have to pay coins to play a level which, that in itself, is absolutely absurd. Then, you can flip SEVERAL cards with not a single move. So many times I can get down to one card and have 8+ cards left, and flip them all either not a single playable move. So, now you are telling me I have to spend coins for a wild or add more cards or just to replay the level? insane

The gameplay is fun...once you finally GET to it. I'd play this game so often if it didn't take sooo long just to actually get to it. All of the in-app purchase, minigames, and event popups are ridiculous and a MASSIVE annoyance. The game would be near perfect aside from that, but there is no way to stop it from happening. It's ridiculous.

This game started off great. As you progress through the levels, however, it becomes incredibly difficult to play without spending money. Coins get drained very fast. I understand it's disney and as a huge dinsey fan myself I was drawn to the app, however, there are many other solitaire options out there that don't try to drain your bank account.

This game is flat out cash grab! it's fun at first, then it takes forever to go to the next scene because doing the solitaire part you run out of cards and you spend tons of coins to finish one level! I had to buy 45k coins and spent all on one level because they aren't fair with the flips! you waste a lot of coins! the wilds are a waste in coins! 9k to get one wild! not worth it! fun at first, but after scene frozen you'll get frustrated! I'm uninstalling! it's not right!

Want to like it, but it's seeming borderline rigged to lose. It's not just wow I'm unlucky. It's I've gotten the same number 3 times in a row, wasting 3 draws. When there's already 2 of said number on the board. Past level 50 and now grinded to a halt fast. Nothing really to even do at this point, I'm not paying for anything in a game that makes their cash grab so obvious.

I have to complete 29 scenes in just over 80 days to get $3 value for a rewards program I'm in. I have spent over $30. I despise this game & I used to like solitaire. You can't watch a video to gain any coins or help whatsoever. I should have just uninstalled in 1 day & downloaded any other game! Do not recommend, it's like gambling, no skill, just chance. I never made it past 12 scenes. This game has been a total waste of my time & $.

the game okay is great and the Disney theme is fun but the pop ups are really annoying. between every round you have to x out of at least three pop-ups. nothing advertising third party things all trying to get you to spend money within the game. Every round costs coins but every hour you can redeem coins. All of the pop-ups trying to get you to purchase extra coins it's just super annoying. I can only imagine someone accidentally clicking purchase instead of x'ing out of the pop-up

I downloaded this game on launch day. It is very cute and fun! I am currently on level 180. However, I had to spend quite a bit of real money to get that far. I feel the game would be more enjoyable with a better cost-to-winnings ratio.bI will continue to play when I can, but I refuse to dump money into the game every other day just to keep progressing. I also feel that most of the mini-games involved are pretty much unobtainable unless you're winning to spend a good amount of money.

So tired of solitaire games that once you get to a certain lol (usually less than a week worth of play), it takes 3 to 5 (or more) hands to actually win a hand & since each win essentially only gets you enough coins to play one more hand, if you don't pay to play you basically get one hand per hr. This is the same. But even worse since it is nearly impossible to or takes forever to win a challenge that could get you more coins. Way more to say but unfortunately not enough room.

This game has so much potential. but due to the ridiculous amount of coins it takes to play it makes it obnoxious. 1st as you advance it requires more coins just to play the level. 2nd it cost an insane amount of coins to purchase +5 cards while you're in a level. And even after you do that, you don't even get cards you can use. if I'm spending 17k coins for just 5 cards, I should be able to use them. if I'm down to 2 cards and have 10+ left I should have usable cards. fix your algorithm.

It's fun except you have to pay in game coins to play each level, as well as for power ups. It'd be way better if you didn't need to pay per level. If you're playing to complete goals in game for pay apps, you will not be able to reach goals on time without spending your own money to buy additional coins to keep playing levels.

its a super fun game and this disney kid loves the idea. the only annoying thing is you run out of coins so quickly. prices keep changing in the game, which makes it hard to do anything. I really don't think you should have to pay to play a level. by the time you finish it, you haven't made any coins. it costs more coins to play the game than what you earn finishing the level. that makes it unenjoyable

Updated: 5☆ for design; 1☆ for failure rate, push for microtransactions, and unfair game play. Reaching higher levels requires increasingly higher coins,and powerups and round extensions cost more than the round itself. Played some levels 20+times to beat, depleting my coins. I paid for 1 bundle, just depleted it, uninstalling the game. Too bad, it's pretty and can be fun, but it's money hungry and manipulative. A total cash grab. Would pay a one-time fee to play.

I really liked this game. However, most of the events are all setup to make you just lose repeatedly unless you want to keep spending money. People will spend money regardless and more if they didn't feel like the game was setup to drain your balance after winning maybe 5 times and actually got to ENJOY the game. On top of that, the levels get very hard very quick, including all the prices of everything goes up quickly. And this is a DISNEY game. I couldn't imagine a child liking this 1 for long

This game is fun but it's way too difficult once you get past the first few scenes. You need 8 characters to build each scene, and the requirements keep increasing. You only get 1 star for winning each level, but it starts to take 10, 12, 15 stars to get each character. So you have to pass 80 or 100 levels just to build one scene?? Then, if you lose a try at a level, you need over 5000 coins to try again. You have to either pay money or wait over an hour to get more coins. Very frustrating!

The game is just okay. It's a mindless game to pass the time. Simply though, the deck works against me, and it has for about the last 40 levels. It will grind you to a halt. You almost have to spend real money daily to make any meaningful progress. I've spent money, but way more that anyone should have to pay for a game like this. You'll lose 6-7 in a row when you haven't bought anything for a while. Save your money, there a 100s of similar games. Unless you're Disney obsessed.

It's a fun game and I like the animations but unless you spend money on coins or wait every hour for more you can only play a few levels at a time. After the first few scenes most things take a lot of stars to move the scene up. Some of the rounds I've played deal me the same card over and over through half the deck im given. It's extremely frustrating.

This app is built to force you to pay to play. Each level costs slightly less than you earn by playing it so that you can't bank enough to restart if you can't beat the round. I enjoy the game, but the most I can win in a row is 3-4 rounds. After that, it depletes whatever I have banked and I still lose then it sends me several offers to pay to play.

I had a 5 star review on this game for over a year. Throughout that time I have spent real money via in game purchases and that's on me. After my progress was taken away when I used a different device to play the game, I expected Customer Support to help me restore what I had lost since using more than one device sounds like design flaw and the items I purchased ARE NOT REAL...they're virtual...fake. Instead they told me they are not liable. They act like there aren't a plethora of other games.

There are so many pay walls its insane. I would not recommend this to loyal gamers and definitely NOT to any children. The graphics are amazing but they deliberately give you cards that mean youll lose a match and set you up to fail unless you pay to progress. Also, when you are about to achieve one of the extra side puzzles, even if you pay actual cash they make it incredibly difficult to get all the puzzle pieces. Its a money making scam.

I love the game, but it is way to expensive. you loose coins during game and have to pay to play the game or quit the level. It even cost to try the level over again. so if you start out with ex. 5000, and you want to flip the used deck it cost 4000, to go back a card 450 coins. so if you dont beat a level, you can't retry because your money goes down while in the game. its not like your even winning real money or anything either. it just gets you to spend more money for more coins.

love the game, butt, yep, there's always a butt that follows. there's not enough hourly reward cash to play any more than maybe one game or two, for most days. I get you're tryin' to make players spend their cash on the game. just raise the reward amount, so one can, at least, play a few games, at that time. instead of spendin' hours checkin'-in hourly, to rack up a few bucks. that's not fun..

Do NOT install this game, it doesnt work as the pop ups are stalling the game and there is clearly a bug on one specific screen. They are fully aware of this, have apologized via their support, but it continues. The bug is causing a pop up screen to freeze, there is no way to close it out and it stops the game from working at all. They know there is problem, they have done nothing to fix it.

This game starts out fun, but it quickly becomes obvious it's designed to make you spend money. Progress slows to a crawl unless you constantly buy coins. It's no longer about skill or strategy, it's about how much you're willing to pay. This is the definition of "pay to progress." Eventually you'll hit a wall where advancing is nearly impossible without spending. What could have been a great game ends up feeling like nothing more than a money grab.

Don't SPEND MONEY!Because the game will keep you stuck at a certain scene. It's rigged! Read the other reviews. Also, don't be fooled by the stars. The game is kinda fun but...... the coins get used extremely fast! Even purchased coins doesn't last after maybe three games. I'm really good at other solitaire games.But, this one seem rigged as if the developers of the game just want you to keep spending money. I don't recommend using any money to get a head. Just use the free coins and be done.

if I could give 0 zero stars I would. don't bother playing this game unless you wanna waste all your money. as soon as you buy something off the app go help you beat a couple levels, all the cards that come out aren't the ones you need and you literally have to spend massive coins for more cards or try to play again. waste of time. oh and you can't beat it WITHOUT spending money.

Paywalls abound after level 50. I can play 1-2 rounds after that due to the cost of each round before I'm prompted to buy, buy, buy. I've also noticed the app stays open in the background even after I select "quit" in-game. I wonder if Disney continues monotoring my activity or pbone use after that? Either way, I always close the app manually too.

I was really enjoying this game until I realized there was no way of earning lives or coins to be able to play levels. I dont understand the concept of "paying" coins to play levels. It makes you spend enough coins to get a wild card or get 5 extra cards to be able to finish the level. Once you run out of coins to play levels, there is literally no way you can play without paying literal money. YOU'RE DISNEY!! YOU MAKE ENOUGH WITHOUT SCAMMING PEOPLE ON SOME SOLITAIRE GAME! How disappointing.

Horrible app! As most of the other negative reviews have already stated, this game is unplayable one you get a little bit into the game unless you spend money. At the beginning it cost about 2k - 2.5k coins to play a level and if you win you get 2.5k - 3k coins back. That sounds like it could work but some levels are just unbeatable unless you spend the extra 5k coins on more cards for that level. This game is made to make you spend money on coins. Completely not worth your time.

Honestly the game will give you enough loot to keep going, it just limits how much you play each day. I just edited my review up a star as there is no excuse anymore with the optional ads, after 10 minutes of ads I had 10-15 games worth of loot. Completely up to me to watch them too. My only criticism now is the diamond mine mini game stinks, rest of the game is gold.

I got this game 4 my freecash app. I kept playing because it has good payouts from my ap. the game itself is trash. it isn't solitaire, it doesn't use a deck of cards, it uses any amount of any card it can 2 make sure u have 2 use all your coins 2 win a round. u can get 6 aces in a row just so it can run you out of cards and you have to buy perks or whatever. the cost of each round, wild & extra draw go up dramatically as u progress. my freecash $$ was barely profit w/ how much this game costs

This game steals your money. Ive spent a lot on this game. I spent $15 just today. I used to love this game. I played otther games apps so I can have money to put towards this game, but play y a game for 3 days to spend $10 and lose it in 1 hour. I learned that can't trust this game at all or what the cards are really going to be because this is a computer game and not an actual deck of cards. I have been able to play longer without paying, these guys are awful. used to be good

I was enjoying this game a lot until they started making it impossible to win unless you spend money to get coins. sometimes they'll let you win, but most of the time you will lose unless you spend money to get to the next round. very disappointing. I really thought this was a good game until I realized what a scam it is. I refuse to buy any coins from them. if I run out of coins, I'll quit playing and every hour I'll collect coins until my coins are back high so I can play again.

pay to win. at first I was having a lot of fun and scenes are really adorable. but I getting incredibly frusterated the higher level i get. I am at level 167 and its purposely setup to hook you in early levels and then eventually scam you into buying stuff with real money, I never do. I have tried this level a couple of times and every time I will grt something like three 3s , three 5s , three As etc back to back to back and I csnt play. this crumbs and scumy and a big scam to make you spend

The positive reviews on this game had to be paid for. The game is rigged to force you to lose levels and spend money. You have to log in every hour to get free coins, they do not stack. There are constant pop ups to spend money, sometimes looping to the point you have to force close the app. Nothing but a blatant money grab.

Love this game! I have never played any game until I was up into levels over 1,000 because they either got too hard to win each level or I just got bored! This game doesn't have either of those problems! There is always something to do! You can play for just a few minutes to collect coins or for longer to win tons of items.

Ive been gaming for 28 years now and this is my biggest issue with these "free" mobile games in general. - Its not skill based. Feels like purposefully bad RNG to get you to spend money on coins. it's either pay up or stop playing. -If a game is "free-to-play" it shouldnt incorporate having to pay-to-play in the game design. Make a good game and charge for extra levels or cosmetics.

The grafics are a bit off sometimes but still nice, "when" you win every other play you only get one star and 1 puzzle piece, to be able to keep playing you have to really invest your money and still will win every other play, 2 300 coins every hour is not enough to keep playing, you can tap in the pack of cards they give, only 5 cards which not even 1 is useful invest another $7 real cash to still fail, why make a nice Disney game if it's not worth it.. 0 stars if possible.

Great artwork as you would expect from Disney. The prizes and reasonably priced "freebies" are colorful and enjoyable, and if you look hard you'll even find a game snuggled amongst them, but you'll spend half your time clearing away "opportunities" to get to it. Seriously, the "buy-me"s are out of control. Rather like Disneyland when you think about it. The game is totally playable without spending, it's just extremely cluttered with pandering.

the actual gameplay is fun, but it's basically pay to play after the first scene. you get a little bit of coins per hour, but you have to log on every hour and it's basically enough to play one level at lowest multiplier. almost every level requires paid help to beat, so you would have to save up coins for several hours just to play. there's also anywhere between 6-10 pop up ads for events, mostly paid, every time you open it. awful.

I really love playing this game and the animations are great, wonderful mini games, BUT the problem is that you charge so much for coins and wild cards, even too much to enter a game. the amounts are insane! I have spent so much money on this game and now need to uninstall this app, before I spend even more. You cannot expect your customers to just keep spending on this game. Do better! Stop gauging us with the ridiculously high amount of coins for everything! you've lost another customer!

Love the Disney characters, BUT... the buy, buy, buy, is horrible!!! The amount of coins required to play each level is WAY out of line for what you earn each level, therefore making you pay, pay, pay!! Also, the coin cost for more cards is ridiculous especially when you need to "buy" 2 or 3 or 4 extra card packs to finish a level, since the card needed doesn't show. It doubles, triples and cleans out your coins. I'm not paying!! I will just play once every few days or uninstall.

love it!! cute, fun, and a trip down disney memory lane... though in the beginning levels are extremely easy. I only purchased coins once, and made it to level 99 and can't not pass the level even with 25,000 coins in my bucket. So at this point I think I hit the wall and can't advance unless I pay a coin package. which now are triple the price than they were in the beginning. So Shame on Disney for that. They make enough money as IS. Boring game graphics but clean crisp gaming experience.

This game is a lot of fun, but it costs an arm and a leg to continue through the levels past around 30. The game also seems to tip favor to itself instead of being random draws. Deleting because of cost. edit 6/15/26. reinstalled about 2 weeks ago, in the hopes that changes might have been made to make it less dependant on spending hard earned money to enjoy. But no.. As you go through the levels, it gets more reliant on paying to continue to play. deleting again and likely this time, forever.

updated review this is a fun solitary game that incorporates Disney characters to keep it fresh. they have tweaked the game so that you don't burn through money quite as quick which makes it easier to enjoy. trying to complete any of the missions is still particularly difficult and likely will cost you a fair amount of coins, but at least you can play it more than once or twice before having to wait 8 hours.

Easy to navigate rules of this particular solitaire ('golf' numerical) game. Hourly opportunities for bonus in-game gold to be used for cost of each game level and amenities. Each chapter themed from a Disney story, with Lion King being first, Little Mermaid second, and so on. Negatives would be how very easily you can go through gold for the price of extra cards needed to complete level. As most games that have in-game currency and extras, the in-game store pops up aggressively.

I was absolutely loving this game!!! UNTIL I leveled up. you get to a point where you can do a round or 2 and then it's just pay to even play. it's SO frustrating I end up closing it and playing a different game that i can actually just play through. they need to add ad watching for coins (not that Disney needs $$ but whatever) or just another way to get coins!! i like the collecting every hour however, it's not much and the average person (work kids school etc) is not logging in every hour...

I want to love this game - BUT - there are way too many pop ups. The game itself is a really fun take on solitaire and appeals to my nostalgic millennial brain, but it's frustrating when you get through a few levels or get close to finishing one of the many rotating tasks, and then the game makes it impossible to move forward unless you pay for more coins. I've been playing for about 140 days and I've spent some money in the game but the way it operates makes me want to delete it.

Was enjoying it, but losing by 1 or 2 cards constantly and cycling through cards that don't match, or cards that have the same card 4 times in a row is done on purpose. I just can't believe how much money they try to get out of the players constantly. The game is good, just really frustrating when almost completing a level and have to wait an hour to get more coins to play another round of cards.

This game is money hungry. But its Disney so what do you expect. You have to get through 5 maybe 7 of the this is on sale deals. You have to spend 2500 coins to play. Its cost double to add 5 cards if you run out. Its cost triple to buy a golden card and if you win you barely get anything back! Make it make sense! Concept of the game is amazing but this game is absolutely money hungry. Don't spend anything on this game. Its not worth it. O and the events are a waste of time.

Been playing since the beginning, I can say this game is really now focused on just taking your money. Not worth it. The new Magical Friend background event was impossible to earn even if you spent hundreds of dollars and played hundreds of levels for hours. I have never seen a harder game in terms of coins and levels needed to be played daily to win. Do yourself a favor and find a different game to download.

Got roped into this game thru an app that you can earn $ thru playing games. The problem is you will spend WAY more than you will ever earn. The game itself is fun, but very rigged for you to lose. You can spend hundreds of dollars on coins that deplete very quickly. You might have to play the same level 7 or 8 times to ever complete it. I would not recommend this game at all. Very expensive to play.

the game is rigged. me and a friend both were at the same level and we both had different star amounts for what it costs to level up. Based on how well you play they increase the star count that it takes to pay for the next upgrade to the scenes. and they make it impossible to play without PAYING TO PLAY. you almost have to and its bogus that they charge insane amount of coins just to play the levels and to earn back is way below the price point of worthiness. save your money, I spent enough.

This game is primarily a cash cow for Disney. It's gambling disguised as a solitaire-style game. There is constant pestering to buy this thing so you don't lose the level, or buy this other thing so you don't miss out on exclusive prizes. It doesn't require skill to play-- just your money 🤑 If only the development team was actually doing anything to implement the improvements they tell everyone they're working on. there's about 1.8 million better apps on the app store for wasting your money on.

Disenchanted! There's no easy way to put this, but Disney has found another way to reach into our pockets and take our hard-earned money. There's no way to reach scenes without having to level-up your coin purchase or win side games without getting the extras in the bundles you can purchase. If this was made for kids, I hope those parents have deep pockets or purchase blocking on their kids phone. The shame Disney 😔

This game is fun and is definitely addictive. The problem, if you are playing for cash, you will spend more than you earn. There is no option to watch ads for points or any way to earn credit unless you win, Unfortunately, you have to pay to win. Also, if you're playing for cash, you can only earn one star per game. Each level needs hundreds of stars to beat and there is no way to multiply those stars. Lastly, after spending your own money to pass levels, the payouts are practically nothing.

I can only describe this game as DEEPLY dissatisfying. Every card, every stack seems purposefully arranged to cost you more coins than necessary. You're forced into using coins for more cards, which quickly gets insanely expensive. There isn't one best solution to each level that allows you to make more coins. They simply drain everything you have so you'll pay real money for more. Save yourself some sanity and give this app a hard pass. The cards are stacked against you from the very beginning.

this is a scam. it advertised no limit to cash out. but omits that the first pay out has to be 25 USD before you can cash out with no limits. it only gives you pennies to play. and when it has a level that says it will pay a high amount when you achieve it , it changes the payout from 26 dollars to 18 cents. that's a big friggin difference.. it's a con. the graphics are all it has going for it

I want to like this game, but it is frustrating. there are multiple times I run through a whole deck without a card that works. so you just lose levels over and over again. there really is no progression. you have to spend money to get further & that's not worth it. you can't even get close to winning any of the big side games because you need too many "butterflies, puzzle pieces, lamps" you name it.

Bad Card Game overall!! the game charges you in-game currency to play each round. It would be fine, except the way the card game works is bad. The game is good. But. You cannot play the next level without paying coins. The prices for each items you'd wanna buy is expensive. And sometimes, I think the game is rigged to make you buy more. the gameplay loop is quite addictive although how it works is different from other solitaire games. whatever card from your deck you pull, you have to go down or up one to place it. this is a pay to play game, but it does give you roughly enough coins every hour to do a play without needing to buy anything. the biggest thing I can brag on is the execution- all Disney characters are in different 3D models with interesting and good animation. they could have completely phoned it in but didn't.

Don't waste your time playing this game. when you actually start enjoying it you'll have to pay if you wanna play because you lose every level and it costs money to buy more coins to play or you have to long on constantly through the day to barely get any coins...the coins given versus wins is disappointing. Game is fun but they are really trying to scam you to buy things. a lot of push adds to buy more content. Keep raising the price of levels and making them more complicated so you would have to pay. it is an excellent and fun game.... for an hour or two. after that it costs more for one game-saving boost than you get in the hourly free coins, and there is no passive coin gain. you have to log in every hour for like 3 hours just to play one hand. very disappointing. if they offered an ad for 25,000 coins or passive coin gain, I'd change my review.

The other 1 star reviews are spot on. I've spent money, around $8, on this game trying to buy coins to win levels. You get close to winning, but never quite close enough before the time runs out. fun game, pretty relaxing, enjoyable animation scenes, but patience based. If you're looking at moving quickly, you will have to make purchases. Other than that, the game is solid. I will update as I play.

The game itself is fine. Cute little Disney Solitaire game with a slight twist. but it loses 3 stars due to the amount of pop ups EVERYTIME you open the game. This would be an amazing app, but all the push to buy buy buy is too much. it's a trap! don't buy a single coin! each level or scene is progressively harder and more expensive! so many ads thrown at you, I've had up to NINE panels of ads to go through just to get to the game screen! every hour you get free coins but just barely enough to play a single hand of solitaire! reward system is designed to keep you from winning anything unless you buy a coin package and they're just not worth it. once I get to level 9 and get my 75.00 gift card, I'll erase the game!

The game itself is fun and the animations when you unlock them are cute, the only reason i took a star away is because there are so many pop ups, about 8. On the plus side, after the daily reset the mass amount of popup only happen once, then a small one after your first play of the day then done.

I really liked this game at first and was spending so much time and effort on it, was even willing to drop a few dollars, but after like scene 5, its just a cash grab. the ratio to coins earned to how much you have to spend per level is just not possible. I would rather have lives or atleast a better way to earn coins, or maybe the coin price to play each level to be lower. its a shame because it had so much potential. also some levels are just straight impossible, wasting so much coins.

this game does offer a lot of ways to make coins, but it doesn't really matter when you consistently lose rounds, just so they can get you to buy more coins. I've had one card left on the board and ran through 14 cards, just to lose. Disney games and to cheat a lot, especially when they're trying to get money out of you. I definitely wouldn't let a child play this game. The same, also, consistently hit you with ads to buy coins, especially when you lose, which is a lot. 2 star, lazy response.

The game was fun for a while, and I would making occasional purchases. But the further you progress, the more it feels like you have to buy coins to keep playing. In one day, I lost over 700,000 coins that's 70+ games. Using coins at the end of a round when only one or two cards remain often costs as much as two or three extra rounds. A win only earns about 10% more than the cost to play, losing just one round can wipe out the profit from many wins. It's designed to drain coins, not reward skill

Every level seems designed to purposely make you fail. It's nothing more than a waste of time at the moment and stops being even remotely fun. Fix this somehow.

It's too bad, because the base game is fun, but the predatory monetization in a game clearly aimed at kids is vile and disgusting. The game is fun and challenging, it seems to make it easier if you've been on a level too long so you can progress. My complaint is every single coin I've spent has been on accident. the game itself would be fun if it wasn't so obvious that this is a cash grab. when I lose a level and don't have enough money to continue, I get hit with at least 4 pop ups of all the ways I can purchase more chances to play. insane that you can't even replay old levels. the game is created to only be completed if you pay. I only downloaded this game for the gift cards reward, and the game is so unplayable that it's immediately getting deleted

A Game that becomes pay to play. The core limit to gameplay is coins. You will run out of coins. Then, you can wait an hour for a small amount that is enough (maybe) for a 1x reattempt. This game is garbage- Solitaire- This game has nothing to do with playing the fun game of solitaire, it has to do with them making money (in-app purchases) Disney- The Disney theme makes it fun, I guess, and unfortunately what will bait a lot of people especially minors in making purchases. Unfortunately the game goes from extremely fun gameplay to putting you in situations where you pretty much need to spend money if you want to progress. This game is great until it's not anymore. In the end, it's a money grab. They let you win like a pro for the first several rounds and then there's a turning point. its a super fun game. it's tolerable if you login here and there just to collect hourly coins and play on the lowest setting for least rewards. Garbage, they charge you coins to play each stage. At the end of each stage, you win less than what you were charged to play. This game is fun, but unless you're going to keep paying actual money to play then I wouldn't recommend it! I really enjoyed this game! It was so fun and rewarding! The only real downside was: that it took a few days (or more) to earn stars for one level... Be prepared to spend money in order to advance in this game, or set an alarm on your phone to log in every hour to collect 2000 coins that you can continue playing. I have been stuck in the Moana level for 3 days now. Very "entertainingly challenging" but as you progress through the levels, scenes, and chapters, the coins go a lot faster, and it gets much more difficult to beat multiple levels in a row. Went from beating 5-8 levels in a row frequently early on, to now maybe 2-4 if I'm lucky. Other than that, it still is a great game, and it definitely will keep you hooked until you run out of coins and have to wait for the hourly/daily bonus unless you buy them ofc. For that reason, I rate it 4.5 stars not 5.

its fun.. until it became a total cash grab. the levels are expensive and so are the "draw five" or "wild card" options. it slowly increases with every "scene" as well. Each scene takes about 20-30+ games per scene which is absurd. Coins are expensive and go to waste almost instantly because of how expensive it is to play a single round. super disappointing.

I tried this app in conjunction with a pay to play app. It is horrible. Not fun and becomes more "expensive" to play as you advance. I hit level 6 and am out of coins unless I pay real hard earned cash. uh, NOPE! Bad animation style. I want to give this game a better review so bad because I love the graphics and its super cute. It feels so greedy after a while because its so obvious they want you to buy things to win after you get like 5 pop-ups in a row. I really hope this is fixed cause I'm losing interest..

Play a different solitaire game, it's pay to win or check back every hour without actually playing a level so you can stock up on coins. The gameplay itself is fine, but the constant pop ups trying to get you to spend money(which is the only way to actual beat some levels because they give you 0 ways to win without spending all your coins) make it annoying to get into the actual game.

Just like the rest.. I got this game thinking "Oh! Disney solitaire how fun!" the game hooks you in with so many wins, and when you get to a certain level... you're just stuck. Scam. So stupid.

it's a solitaire grand harvest knock off. once you get about 100 levels in it doesn't matter how good you are it just goes by if you get the right set of cards so no skill just luck. not too mention it'll get to the point where you'll only be able to try a level once per hour if you don't spend money. and no it doesn't build up you have to log on every hour to claim the free gold which is exactly enough for 1 level try. not a good enough game to even think about spending money on

This game is unplayable in the high levels without spending money. Even then, the game is designed to force you to lose. I've spent money several times in hopes to win and it is absolutely rigged. All risk, no reward. I love that there is no ads, but thats it. Disney is capable of making a game that you get what you put into it -their matching games, even emoji blitz- Disney Solitaire is NOT one of those games.

This game plays at minimum 10 ads for in game purchases before EVERY SINGLE GAME. That ensures that the game controls which levels you win and which you lose 100% of the time. So, in conclusion... more ad time than game play time in a controlled environment where your play determines absolutely nothing. Enjoy

fun at first, however the ads have become obnoxious; you have to sift through 4-6 (sometimes more) just to get to the actual game and notifications have gotten out of control. at first it was every hour which is when next free round was available. now it's anywhere from 15, 30 &/or 60 minutes at which point you have to sift through all the ads to find out next free round is not yet available.

Gross - Can't Win if you Don't Pay They don't even give you lives. If you get stuck on a level you HAVE to log in every hour to collect coins. I am really, really enjoying Disney Solitaire. I have no complaints about the gameplay whatsoever, but devs....all the popups upon starting the app are insane!!?!!? Disney Solitaire is honestly a very fun and addictive game. The graphics are beautiful, the Disney themes are nostalgic, and there are several ways to earn extra coins while playing. The gameplay itself keeps you interested and wanting to continue to the next level. My biggest issue is how expensive everything becomes as you try to progress, and the amount of stars needed to complete 1 task is ridiculous, so it can become a money pit fast. so I get my several people are complaining 🙄

Fun game but it is a money pit. Sometimes it will give you a good chance to win a level and get prizes but to often it lets you get right to the edge of winning and then snatches the rug under you. The scaling is bad as the cost to play gets more expensive. I also feel like I don't get all my rewards when I purchase immediately it waits until I spend coins and then they magically appear. Also, when you have wild cards or bonus decks, the game really turns on the cheating.

I originally wrote about how scammy this game is. I do think the game developers are trying to make it more fun and worthwhile so I gave an extra star. That said, spending gives much more access to daily events which makes it more fun. Overall, if I wasn't earning money by playing, this game probably would not be my go to solitaire.

This game is a waste of time and money. They charge too many coins to beat levels and you don't get that many for winning. It takes forever to get any coins from the side quests which a lot of them reset if you don't win the levels. The only way to win most of the levels is to keep buying stacks of cards which quickly adds up to an insane amount of coins to beat one level. This game could be fun if the made it so you don't have to spend a fortune to get anywhere.

PAY TO PLAY! I've spent hundreds of $$ on predatory offers to continue playing the game. I was looking for an alternative to Monopoly Go, that is now too greedy and expensive to enjoy that game at all. Don't bother downloading this trash. It literally takes longer for the app to open than for it to automatically crash and exit out. This game sets you up for failure. You get to play a bunch of levels at first but you slowly run out of gold. once you run out you can't play anymore unless you spend money or claim free gold every hour. It's a decent game if you want to kill some time. The gameplay can be satisfying at times. Oh man this is NOT casual play. I don't write reviews, but this game is so horrible that it warrented a review. I've never played a game that activly wants to keep you from playing it. This game is way too expensive. You cannot play without spending actual money. So many times you get to the end of a level and have to buy more cards 4 or 5 times to be able to finish. I am about to be so brutally honest! Firstly, The solitaire is fun, I guess. I like most of the reward systems. Gameplay. LIKE 8 OF THEM! SO ANNOYING! Nothing dampens my experience with a game like immediate popups!

it's basically gambling. nothing random about the deals, not real solitaire. straight up fixed 100% in an attempt to get your money. if you are doing well, it's not you, you aren't good at the game or smart. it's their algorithm throwing you a bone to key you interested. doing badly? algorithm thinks it's got you locked in and it's trying to get your money. I gave it two stars because it's cute but shame on Disney for putting their branding on this shameless fixed slot machine.

This game is great at first! But then comes the pay wall after a certain point. You will start to notice when the greed of the developer takes over and you realize its incredibly hard to progress with spending real life currency.

Updated review 2. This game deserved a higher rating than I had given it due to the cost for gameplay. After further play with a strategic approach to cost. very predatory system. you will be forced to pay eventually. the levels and items required to finish them cost more and more. faster than you make money for beating levels. a better title would be like, "inflation simulator". you get free coins every hour you log on, but they aggressive shove literally 5-10 ads begging you to pay in your face before you can click the button to claim them. just kills the playing motive

had to hit X on at least 12 things before I can play a round every time I open the app. more times than not I have to buy extra hands of cards because the cards given the last several are of no use and repeat. and sometimes even the extra cards bought are of no use. costs coins to play a hand. costs double the price of the hand to buy a few extra cards. pushes far too hard for you to spend actual money.

the game never works. and once you get into a good groove, the game shuts down and all progress is lost. game shouldn't be out on the market. not fair game play. maybe because the game has rewards available and Disney and other people don't want you or certain people to win so they hack the gameplay so you can't win. or the game is full of bugs and Disney knows and is cheating it's customers once again. you pick. how can I contact you through the game if it doesn't work. it won't stay on.

This game is super fun! There are a couple of downsides: #1 would be popups to make in app purchases take like a whole minute to go through. starts as a fun mahjong type game, quick becomes one of the biggest cash grab games I've ever seen. many levels leave you with rng making 80% of seeds unfinishable without buying upgrades. the currency in game gives you about 1 try at a level per hour, assuming you log in every hour on the hour to redeem. most of the time you need to redeem 4-7 to actually finish the level.

my experience in the beginning was great was able to complete levels and move up and grow in the game. currently sitting at level 286. my issue with game is once you get high in the game it stops setting you up to beat the level your on so you burn through your coins and then gives ad after ad after to purchase coins and other things and once your own money has been spent it sets you up again to make runs on levels. game is rigged to spend money not play and beat levels freely. consumerfraud imo

like the Disney part that's it. after a certain point it costs more in currency than it does to play the level. Fun but as soon as you hit a certain level you pretty much have to spend money. Went through 30k in coins on the same spot and never won. Excellent game, terrible money-grab tactics. I love playing this game, but it has been glitching constantly. the game has gotten ridiculous in the amount of coins I need to play just one hand from one of the richest companies on the planet first off. fun game, annoying experience. the actual game play is so fun but the constant pop ups to try and make you pay for the game is relentless. takes me a full 2 minutes before I can even start playing the game between all the pop ups they start with when you open the app. and no they are not ads so its nice but its still way too much.

it would be a great game if it weren't rigged to make you lose/run out of coins. it is not actually solitaire because of this. it "randomly" generates cards and as soon as you start to do well, the game stops giving you the appropriate cards. it's overrun with ads. fascinating. until i made it to level 22. then they wanted me to pay money to continue playing since I ran out of credits for whatever it was worth. it is an interesting game great for killing time. it would be better if I could actually win money playing it and have it deposited directly to my PayPal account. but no games are willing to pay out like they promised when they are just newly released. most are just scams or online fraud.

UPDATED REVIEW--on lvl 1300 (spent alot to get here, no more)love the game and all the side games HOWEVER they do NOT give/win enough coins even with the side games to play unless u spend money. great concept but its only for the developers to get more & more money not for people to have fun without purchase everyday. 1st started to play the game and this my review-----very addictive and get a little upset when I dont have enough money to play and have to keep collecting money to play. love it.

the game is fun to play in the beginning but now that I really am liking it and want to continue to play it I find it is rather costly and it is not affordable for me to continue on a fixed Iincome because the farther into game the higher the amount it asks for to play for the same card layout . it just seems rather deceptive and very wrong to me so I will just have to play less and since it also makes you wait for such a very long time between to get the free amount to play nother hand or two.

The app itself is fine, good graphics, runs smoothly, no ads (That I saw), but the GAME sucks.

Exactly as all other reviews have said, this game is clearly forcing you to pay more money in order to progress at all. The coins you get every hour are not even enough to start a level. Designed to make you spend money. Even if you make a purchase it's impossible to get ahead. Cost to play vs how much you win if you complete the level is minimal.
