These are the same coins you need to even start a level so unless you're ready to spend real money on coins I wouldn't recommend downloading this game.

The more you play and more levels you achieve.... the worse the games gets. The cost for extra cards is outrageous and make you go through 3-4 extra stacks which is ridiculous!!! They've started making some games where you purposely lose to bully you into spending the money to win games, events, etc. I'm an idiot for spending my money thinking the game would get better. For a game using Disney's name, they should be ashamed of themselves! In my opinion it's worse than Monopoly Go.

It was a fun game, now there are so many pop ups to just get to play. "You won this , come buy this, etc... and now we have changing cards. conveniently unplayable most of the time without going through all of your cards and then using your coins to buy more cards...

Things I like: There is good variety in how the cards are dealt/stacked, there are opportunities to compete that are fun but not mandatory if you're not into that, collecting the parts to each picture is fun and the little animations are cute too. Things I find frustrating: The paywall/gating is such that if you run out of coins, the collectible allotment is not quite enough to play one hand and does not compound, logging in has too many pop-ups so it feels like it takes forever to start.

Love the game but the in-game pop-ups for prizes, levels, challenges, and purchase deals is waaaay too much. There are icons for everything already. One can click to find what they're looking for. I don't need 10 pop-ups as soon as I open the app.

Love the game and the disney characters but you don't earn enough coins when you win to play the games and will end up having to make an in app purchase. Some of the things you earn you can only use a few of before it forces you to have to pay for something in order to use the rest of your winnings.

Game is very scammy feeling. Quickly you run into multiple levels where you can't beat them without spending more coins to gain additional cards or wild cards in order to best it, through no fault of your own. The level was never able to be beat cleanly. So this isnt really a puzzle game, more of a luck generator hoping the layout is beatable unless you want to spend actual money to continue or wait several hours before you have enough coins to play again. To response : I'd bet money you're not

Way too much going on in this game and it's become a cash grab at this point (and it's not even subtle...) When I start the game, I have to close no leaa than a dozen pop ups for some weekly event (that is for a price, of course). I swear it takes 5 minutes just to get to the game Once you get past a certain level, it's crazy expensive because the game wants you to spend real money. We're not even pretending it's not a balatant cash grab at this point...

I've never left a review on a game before but this one deserves it. I'll say the good thing first. It's fun to play, when you can. The cost to play for rounds is ridiculous and only getting to play one game per hour after you ran out of tokens is sad. At least do a free version that doesn't count towards progression. The game is 100% rigged to make you want to pay for one of the 10 bloody pop ups they SHOVE in your face every time you open this horrendous app. It does NOT make me want to buy.

I give my lowest rating, so far, because while the game is fun, today I spent $5 to be able to keep playing for a while and as soon as I purchased I lost every game until the coins were gone. Less than 10 minutes of play time. Each game forced me to buy the 5 extra cards and the first 3 times, my card was the first one and the last 2 games my card wasn't there. Oh well, I won't be making any more in app purchases with this game. Ever. Paying $2.50 every 5 minutes is out of the question.

Changing my review. HOW does this game have such a high rating? Before I could even start playing the actual game, I had to close **13** ads!! After the first game, 6 more popped up. I am going to delete the app, even though I have made purchases through it, because the ads make it feel like a cheap knock-off of something good Disney could have done.

I love playing this game but it's ridiculous how much money you have to pay to just keep going!! I've never played such an expensive game like this one! So it cost 10,000 coins to play the game at 4x and then when you win you might make 13,000 coins and that's if you don't have to buy extra cards that cost 17,500 coins for 5 cards and most of the time you gotta buy 2 or 3 sometimes 4 sets... it's crazy how you don't barely win any coins but yet cost so many coins to even play it!

Most aggressive monetization I've ever seen! You're typically bombarded by about 7 pop-ups every time you boot it up, because most events only run for one day. Price to play, extra cards, and wild cards all creep up in price over time, leaving the hourly coins you can claim far behind. If you wish to actually participate in events, you MUST be playing the higher tier play - which of course costs 5x as many coins to play and you'll barely break even so long as you don't use any extra cards.

While the game is fun and whimsical, gives free coins hourly, and is addicting to play. the game however requires you to progress by using coins, power ups, etc. If you want to keep playing you need coins/power ups and coins/power ups require money, its optional but also its a requirement. I had to wait almost 3 hours to try a level again, just because the wild card cost me 2,5k gold to use. Either free coins need a boost or give us a 99cents option.

at first I thought this game would be great for kids. learning numbers and Disney theme would keep them interested but after around level 40 or so it just started consistently giving puzzles that are impossible to solve without costing $ . I feel like Disney is preying on children for money in a very unfair way. disgusting! don't spend $1 on this app !!

After having played through over 300 levels, it's quite obvious this game is designed as a cash grab. The starting cards are generated randomly and every newly revealed card is determined based on the current face-up cards. The longer you go without spending coins the more the game will generate unusable cards, forcing you to restart for a fee or buy wild cards. The bonus coins you get are set to the same cost of starting a level and must be manually claimed every hour (1 free round per hour).

I like this game! The card game is fun and the Disney scenes are amazing. But there are coins in the game, and the way the game is set up, you slowly lose more coins than you earn. Then they keep trying to get you to pay real money for more coins. From $1.99 to about $11 for coins and other things. I would rate the game 5 stars if there was a way to keep playing for free, and more coin rewards. I would be willing to watch ads to get more coins or another way to get coins easier.

There has been multiple times I jave been granted coins and not actually given these coins or food from baskets and I get nothing in my pantry added. This typically happens when first logging in for the day and you're met with the many pop up prompts for everything. The games algorithm is definitely pay to win some of the stuff like the last puzzle or getting the last portion of any event. When I spent money and got a lot of coins everything drastically increased as well.

I have reached the point in the game where it is essentially pay to play. I pretty much am only allowed to win one level a day unless I watch ads. No matter how perfectly I play the levels, I am not allowed to pass them. It has become stale and boring. Fun for a while, but like all "free" games, you eventually need to pay to progress. Great while it lasted though.

Deceiving...just another game you can't get ahead unless you spend actual money. This game starts out pretty easy, but as you progress you quickly find out that it takes a lot to level up, you have to lose a lot in order to win one game (only to earn 1 star if you're playing on the easy level), and finishing scenes takes too many stars. This game has proven to be quite disappointing, considering some levels you are set up to fail so many times before you can actually win the solitaire match.

I'm right on the borderline of liking and hating it. You have to login to collect coins once an hour and don't accumulate automatically. You're so often 1 card away from finishing and if you need to use a chat, it uses a massive amount of coins. Levels are so long and take so many stars to beat. The game is so hard to be successful at unless you buy coins and if you do, they're gone right away. They bombard you with their own in-game pop ups. Annoying.

Not Solitaire really. Also, it is extremely hard to win once you get in the upper levels unless you pay money for coins. I am up to almost level 500 and at a "bonus" level. It is not a bonus level at all to me when I have to constantly play levels to get coins and it costs too many coins to unlock one thing. Needs to be changed and made more affordable in my opinion!

I had to come back and edit my review. I love the game, but as others have stated, the more you play, the more it costs you - you're given fewer cards to complete the level and fewer 'matches.' So you 'purchase' more cards and it can cost 50,000 to 100,000 coins to complete the level - you can have 350,000 coins and after 1 round, not enough coins to play another level and then the levels cost more to play! it's an awful cycle that I didn't want to believe until I couldn't ignore it!

I have tried to enjoy this game. While the game is technically "free to play", it is designed for players that pay to play. Most rounds you cannot win without using helps, which use up your accrued game currency quickly. The game has a lot of events/promotions that you accrue tokens for through game play. Most of these events you have to pay to play or pay after the first level or two. If you have a ton of patience, you can play for free, but be prepared for constant pushes to spend money.

I've been playing this game for a few months now & it has so many pop up ads to purchase is so annoying. Also it's almost near impossible to play for more than 15 minutes. You use to be able to chose to watch ads to earn more coins but not anymore. You only get basically 1 play every hour and it doesn't accumulate....so you have to go into the app every hour to collect. Not worth playing anymore. I did enjoy it while it lasted.

it's fun, but why is everything so expensive? it costs so many coins to play a level, and then if you don't get lucky with the cards you could end up nearly depleting all of your coins in a single game. it's not an f2p friendly game, and I wish the game was more lenient on that. the mini events in the game are impossible to complete unless you have the money to spend on bundles or the time to spend grinding carefully for these items. it's fine for casual gaming, but costs too much money to play

They made it so you have to PAY TO WATCH ADS. You'll watch a bunch of ads to earn coins and whatnot and suddenly it will cost $1.99 to continue or else you'll lose your progress and not get to collect the prize you were working towards. The only way the game was playable was to watch ads to earn stuff. Now it's pointless unless you plan on spending money. Their reply asking me to email for support is bizarre, almost as if they didn't even read my review. This is not a bug, it's intentional.

Great game, solid game play, but it's basically 100% pay to win. Once you're out of coins (which are easy to accidentally spend) you only get one refill (ie ONE PLAY) per hour. Who has the patience for that? And if you don't pass a level you can't reset it to try again, you have to replay it and that costs coins so you just have to wait an hour to do a re-deal. What a money grab.

Honestly if I wasn't playing this due to a reward app I'd never touch this absolutely awful game. Many levels feel doomed from the start, and it feels deliberate in order to get you to pay for more coins. I've had far too many situations with just one card left and 5 in the deck, none of which let me win - or multiple useless cards in a row from the draw. Not saying there's no skill involved but the luck element is too big. Oh and only getting coins every hour IF you open the app is heinous.

Good game play but unless you put actual money into it, its a losing battle. As you need coins to enter a game, you only get back about a quarter in winnings as what you put in. It's all set up as a cash grabbing app. Games and cards get more expensive as you go along and almost impossible to get the "free extras" like collecting cards and winning games first round unless you invest a small fortune. Pop-ups within the game are annoying too. Deleting.

great card game, I like the various styles of gameplay. but the pop-ups to buy in-game stuff are ridiculous. not to mention the cards aren't an actual deck. you will have SEVERAL of the exact same card and suit and next to nothing of other cards, making being able to win a game next to impossible. so of course you spend all the allotted money on games within an hour. and your earnings is next to nothing, making it where you really can't play nearly as much as I would like

Great game, lovely music - shame I can only play one round at a time without paying for coins as it's not a game where "lives" regenerate. You use in-game currency to pay per level you play and you get enough for one game per hour (and a top up if you win a round). If you don't collect the coins each hour, they don't store up so you can't collect more later on - no matter what time you log on, you get one hour worth of coins. I would give 5 stars if you got enough for 3 goes at a time at least.

The gameplay itself is fine and fun, but the game is sooooo evidently rigged towards making money, it's baffling. The average expenditure is 3 to 4 times what you can earn per game. This leaving the player waiting for the free coins, or paying real cash. Not to mention the 7 or 8 pop-ups geared towards buying stuff before you can actually access the game. I understand paying the Devs, but there's a point where remuneration becomes greed. Unless this changes quickly, I'll delete.

The game is nice and casual for the first 100 levels or so. But after that, it costs so much to play a single level and there's no other way to replenish energy other than logging in every hour to claim the coins for ONE play. I also have a feeling that the cards are not shuffled fairly. There were times I drew 8 cards and didn't get a single card that would help me continue. This game is predatory to the bone and it wants you to spend money to play. Extremely F2P unfriendly.

The game is super fun and was one of my favorites but it's completely rigged after a certain level. It purposely doesn't give you the cards you need so you end up spending coins to progress. I managed to figure out a pattern, you can win 1-2 games free everyday, afterwards you gotta spend real money or the in game coins which you also need to play every level (and spend to retry every level)

Could have been a great game - easy to play and graphics are brilliant but geared too much towards pay to play. You earn coins at the end of a completed level but then have to spend nearly all of them to play the next level so you're left with nothing to buy help when the cards don't fall right unless you purchase more coins!

the fact that you only get enough coins in your hourly bonus to play one game and then if you want to use any extras (wild, undo, extra 5 cards) you actually spend more coins than you would make if you win the game is a little ridiculous. I understand they want people to spend real money on the game but it is next to impossible for broke people like me to play more than one hand at a time because it's unaffordable via free coins.

I'm sorry playing this type of solitaire is always interesting. Unfortunately, playing this one in particular is not really motivating because once you are out of money and you get stuck on a level, you have to wait to earn some momey only to lose again, and then you have to replay again and again... real buzz kill 🤷‍♀️

A wonderful mix of solitaire and Disney magic!The card game is fairly basic solitaire but with clear, colorful graphics and, of course the enchanting music and sounds which only Disney can produce. Plentiful power ups and rewards are given and appearances by favorite characters abound. Disney and solitaire are a great mix!Give it a try. It's a winner!

Game can be fun. Many unwinnable levels, but can get through eventually. Gives you three different prize options for starting the level, which cost more coins, but you don't win anything if you dont pass a level, so you run out of coins fast if going for the top tier. OBNOXIOUS POP UPS when first entering the game with real money offers. Having to click exit on 6 or 7 pop ups when entering the game. Being at level 450, I do not need an explanation on how pooh's honey tree works.

I enjoy these games, but the RNG in them is ALWAYS terrible. You can be doing well, then all of a sudden - you lose like 20x games in a row trying to finish 1 level. I'll take breaks after every 3 losses to see if the RNG resets, but nope, still lose over and over unless I use wild cards or extra cards. I had like 100k coins saved up and lost it all on one level, with the lowest entry cost too. I don't want to spend again to get more coins. Edit: RNG is still garbage.

A very fun & addictive game! I enjoy playing it on a daily basis, and, it's definitely getting more difficult! That's a great thing for brain training. I take my time now, making sure that I don't just pick the play that clears the most cards. You have to try to look at the board & play a step ahead. I do wish that there was a way to "X" out of the "scene" so I don't have to watch it & can get right back to the next deck.

Edit: Played to level 200 and confirmed everything I mentioned in my first review. It's not that the game is bad, it's just really boring and obviously too dependent on micro transactions to make it worth playing for any period in excess of two or three games at a time. If you want a game that last longer per session,play Domino Dreams. It's practically a cookie cutter copy in terms of aesthetics, bonuses and boring gameplay, but a bit less grabby.

Love the animation and individual song themes. The album card collecting is one of my favorite parts. But I'm seriously spending too much on this game just to complete scenes. It can take forever to complete the finale scene AND get the last lvl of rewards, so give me more to spend, please!! and don't bother using coins for wild or extra cards. It's not worth the coins. Just start over. The system likes to have you wastes coins at least 3-4x before you can win as you progress.

The game is now completely unplayable due to the Paysafe Card Cashback offer, and I don't even live in a country where the Euro is used as currency. Every time I try to X out of the offer, it just cycles through all the In-game store offers making it so I can't even play any levels.

I have just started playing but so far I like it! The scenes you build are so reminiscent to the shows that it is like re-watching them! So far, I am able to earn enough coins that I haven't needed to purchase any, which is a nice surprise. However, I just finished the third scene, so... we will see how long that stays true...🤷‍♀️ Yes... If you enjoy solitaire, I would recommend this game.

Absolutely terrible format in regards to the in-game currency. It "costs" an extortionate amount to even start a level and the money does not regenerate on its own over time. Then the in-game costs for boosts are even higher with no other way to get them other than completing levels (or spending actual money which I won't do). If you actually complete a level, the reward money is only just higher than the initial cost to play! So you "spend" more than you win.

I'm /was obsessed with this game. I think I'm on level 5000 or so now and it's getting ridiculously hard to pass, the cards and settings don't make sense. managed to win about £400 just from playing it though, in about a month and a half, so happy with that. I doubt I'll put more time in it apart from a quick daily mission. no ads though. huge bonus.

If playing this because of a cash app like Testerup - Do not waste your time, and especially your money. The ability to complete stages quickly slows down and in order to continue playing you need coins, which costs money. It's very easy to get sucked into spending more money on the game than you can feasibly earn back, as there are so many tactics employed ingame to push microtransactions and "deals" to the player. It feels not much different to how online casinos hook you.

4 July spin doesn't have an exit option. just need to keep closing the game and hoping that the spin doesn't appear. I saw that there was a suggestion to use the in-app support. I would if only I could get to it rather than being stuck on the"spin" screen. Some levels are tricky but after spending a load of coins you get past it... sooner or later. suggestion is that the retry of the game should cost half the coin to make it less defeating. and why do games get more expensive?

Rverything in this game costs the in game currency and the amount you get without paying is very limited. Rounds of the solitaire itself seem essentially unbeatable without paying more of that very limited in game currency for buffs. There gets to be a point where the game is essentially unplayable without spending money. If you're a Disney adult and willing to spend that money you may still have fun.

this game used to be fun but realistically if you dont spend money you going no where, secondly when you do spend money you use it so quickly as you can't get through the levels now I am on level 3000 and something, speaking from experience yes in the beginning it was great but now it's just a money making scheme and the sad thing is a really enjoyed this game. until about a month ago and since then I can't be bothered after spending money and getting hardly any rewards back.

This game is amazing with the sounds and lovely Disney characters to build up with the side games. making enough coins in the day is hard and may need looking at. log in and playing a game without ads. I repeat WITHOUT ads is brilliant. You don't need to purchase coins. Just wait for timer free clocks build up during the day then. play time at night 4Stars for the enjoyment.

You have to use in game currency to even play a level, then use that same currency for more cards in said level to match up with what you have left. Then if you can't beat that level cause you have no more in game currency, you can't repeat the level you've already paid to play.... Absolute con. Literally only playing through a reward app like many others. No wonder they need these apps to lure people into their games. And cue the generic response of " thanks for feedback.... Trying to improve"

I enjoy the game but its too hard to get coins to play for any amount of time or progress/get rewards without spending money constantly. it is a very money hungry game. fed up with it really. cost of items is too much i blew through 300k coins within an hour. I have spent money on this game and I wish I hadn't. levels cost coins, mulitpilers cost coins, additional cards x5 cost 5900 coins rarely has a card in you need, wild card to get rid of the final card 11k coins. lots of complaints on this.

Playing for a reward app. The in game currency earned does not match what in game currency you spend. Double cards in packs and always seem to pick cards I need after spending to add to the hand - only to be rewarded with less of a coin total than when you went in with. Then here comes the kicker, after the game has you wasting your coins you're flooded with purchase offers for real money. I get that Developers need to earn but you won't get a lasting paying player base by deception.

DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS GAME!!!!!!! ITS RIGGED. I was doing really well as I got higher and invested money to play it. I noticed how they have rigged it so as I bought more coins, what would happen is the cards became more scarce to help you finish. which meant you were backed in a corner and had to purchase more cards to be able to finish. which are through your in-game money. the same with the prizes in the mini games. it's not worth it I invested over £50 and they screwed me. so do not be fooled

this can be a fun game to play; however, there are too many in-app purchases, too many 'events' that don't last long enough to achieve any of the goals, never an opportunity to collect all of the cards in the album collections. If the developers don't want to award high coin prizes to many players, then don't offer high prizes. I would rather be able to complete an album than win hundreds of thousands of coins. I'd prefer easier achievements & lower prize amounts

Game itself is fun & looks nice but the hurdles to progress get super high very fast. I'm at scene 10 (of 60) and need over 40 stars to progress the scene by one single stage (there are 10 stages total). That's insane. You can only collect 2-3k coins per hour & there's no way to earn more i.e. by watching ads. I bought a few small bundles over time but even with that progress is still extremely slow and pretty much ground to a halt at this point. Very disappointing to be honest.

No difference to other solitaire games except you can't just open the game and play. You are hit by at least 5 "buy me" in game ads as soon as you open the game! No progress without paying so don't bother, unless you are happy to save everything over the week to have one day where you can get a little progress. Not worth it just for Disney characters!

the game is fine enough but there are two annoying things that Ive found. the first is just the discrepancy between coins earned vs the ones you need to use to keep playing. the other other, is that the cards work against you. you'll have one card left to win and multiple left to flip. you'd think one would be useful! but no! then you're left with a choice: use an absurd amount of coins for a more cards (possibly useless ones), or end the level (and lose any challenge progess)

Entirely pay to win, there's only one currency & it's coins, the levels get difficult after a while and make it impossible to play without using more coins. No ads to get more.I basically have to wait for the coin bonus then play a level and if I lose that level I'm screwed till the next bonus. It starts really good, you get loads of coins and loads of wins and you play it quickly but then all of a sudden it's difficult and your coins run out FAST. It's a shame because it's a really good game.

VERY predatory. Fun game but it pushes in-app purchases like crazy. I could even say they rig levels to force you to spend coins or you fail it. Really upsetting as I love solitaire. Would NOT recommend if you want casual free solitaire. EDIT: 100% rigged to make you spend endless money. I have been stuck on the same level for almost 24 hours now and have spent over 50k coins on this one level alone. Balance? Yeeeeah right.

It seems most levels are geared towards only being winnable either after several attempts or by purchasing additional cards. Game play credit only refills slightly, once an hour. The graphics are great, with lots of Disney characters and scenes to build from credits gained when you win a game. But it's clearly geared toward pushing purchases which is a shame especially for a kid friendly game.

The game itself is fun, unfortunately its covered in paywall after paywall. It asks you to pay money multiple times when just opening the game. Then when you play and eventually 5 will give you between 5-6 different options to pay for more coin. Playing a game costs so much in game money that you might be able to play one game then run out. Its frustrating, I am sure there are similar games without the constant pressuring for money. I can only give 1 star due to the annoying pay to play

I am on 1400 level. I play every day and spend more than $300. But I can say one thing... Greedy developers!!! there is no easy game flow unless you pay. When you pay you will briefly feel the true joy of the game, but then one level will come and literally take away all the coins. I had 1mln coins and waited for a single card to drop yet I lost. all events designed to never be completed if you don't pay continuously.

the game is addictive and fun, but, PLEASE tell me why I am on level 470, paying 11,400 coins and Still not playing for more than 1 Star to progress?? The game throws many multipliers at you but refuses to award more than one gold star, even with Epic x4 multiplier, even at level 400. The cost of playing a game increases every 20 levels or so, but paying 11,400 coins Only to receive a pay-up of about 2000 coins is disgusting.

This game is such a scam. It gives you very little coins (a little over 2000 per hour), while 1 try at a level costs 2500 coins. If you are FTP and save the coins through logging in or rewards, the game will literally feed you unsolvable levels (unless you buy rediculously expensive powerups and helpers) until you are back to almost no coins again. I lost 43000 coins on 2 levels after saving up, and this is not the first time this has happened.

Impossible to win regularly without paying and if you do manage to win the rewards are barely enough to keep playing they also shrink after a loss. Often you will get multiple cards in a row that you can't use at that moment meaning that you can't win that round, you can get additional packs of cards to try and make it through but good luck getting any you can actually use to complete the round. Or you can buy a wild card for much more than the cost of another attempt.

they're very stingy with rewards and play coins and they give 0 perks. for example I just crossed level 1000 and there was no reward. every other game rewards you for crossing milestones. it almost seems like the game is made more for sales of packs and not for the players to have a good time. I'm losing interest in the game and will probably uninstall it soon. I don't recommend this game

Such a disgusting game, it is made to make you lose and spend more and more, until you must pay to play more. The same stage when you repeat it has different cards, so it usually makes you fail the first time and succeed the second. Since its Disney themed, I don't even understand who is their target audience. Save your time and play something else.

Coin Trap avoid!!!! Graphics ate very good. the game is very generous in the beginning for coins and prizes. Tou get justbthe cards need to finishnthe level. But when you hit 40K coins or so, when the levels start to advance you start not to get the cards and you need and you have to ask extra cards which is 1.5 times the game price. then even with single extension you can not find the cards you need you go for second and third extension. So you start to loose 10 times more then you win.

Disappointingly dull game. The ads lead you to believe there's a certain level of storyline and interactiveness in the gameplay, but there's nothing of the sort. You just play solitaire, and get pieces to put together scenes that you aren't even able to interact with. Tons of wasted potential :( Edit: I didn't say anything about the coins or cost.. it's just a very boring, non-interactive game.

Starts off with a form of solitaire. pretty decent overall. But it's just another typical cash grab. You earn coins by completing a level of some achievement. but most of those coins are used just to start a level. There's a cost to start a level. Then if you run out of cards, there's a cost to buy more. which increases as you progress. my leat favorite part is the stars required for the scenes, which jumps dramatically when you reach the Moana scene. From an average of 3-4 stars to 11+ for each

The coin situation is getting really annoying. Use your coins to actually play a level?! Seriously?! Use more coins to reshuffle the cards. Definitely a better way to do this. Recommend a friend who played 20 levels and no reward given as the game promised. The game is no longer fun with this coin issue. I also keep getting notifications about events and when I click on it... Absolutely nothing. Don't recommend it.

Great game - ANNOYING PAYMENT POP-UPS It's not quite like solitaire but still fun enough to keep me playing. I like building the scenes. However, there are at least 8 blooming pop-ups asking if I want to purchase the "Spring", "Hades", "Ratatouille", "Monsters Inc", "Bolt" and more packages. It ruins the feel of the game. Too many payment options actually makes me not want to purchase any. Too complicated.

This game has so much potential, the gameplay is so much fun, but it is literally impossible to win after a certain point unless you buy in game currency. The game is so clearly rigged against you, there will be one card left on the table, and 8 left in my pile, and not one of them will match with the card on the table. Getting extra cards, or using a wild card costs double the coins it costs to even play, you can easily spend over 15,000 coins trying to win a single game.

when you get through the 10+ pop ups that appear when you open the game, it's pretty good. the actual solitaire part is fun and it has mechanics that make it interesting, but the blatant money grabbing is almost unbearable. you can always tell when the game will stop letting you win, and when it'll be nice to you again because you're short on coins. it's borderline predatory since this is a Disney game that kids will likely find and play.

The game itself is okay initially, then the cost of playing is just stupid, you can easily lose 100,000+coins each level, I've lost over 200,000 in one game. Absolutely love the game and the graphics. I look forward to creating new scenes especially of the movies I love. The BIG downside... game play is rigged, spend too many in-game coins for levels and in-game support, quickly run out of currency, don't receive enough coins each hour to play a level. Takes ages to progress in levels, bonus games are over too quickly to achieve anything. So much potential but sorry no more purchases from me.

needs to be more skill based rather than needing to buy coins & more ways to obtain coins. Puzzle results seem to be randomly determined at the start of the level you'll either fail or pass based on RNG!

Not impressed, the more you play this game the more money you loose. To start with you have to pay money to play a level!!!! The price for levels keeps rising, plus you have to pay for cards and the price doubles then triples. There is no way you can get ahead without buying from them. Huge money grabbing! Big disapointment from Disney, I expected more.

The game is almost completely geared towards monetisation, in an exploitative way. You need to pay coins to play a game, if you win, you win slightly more than you paid to play, and if you need to use any bonuses during a game, that costs way more than playing a game. The model is to get you to play, try to encourage addiction to the game, then make it impossible to play without spending money. Awful

Game is what it is: Fairway Solitaire meets Disney but made in a way that (if kids were to play this), they would be asking their parents to buy the coins needed to play. I've reached the 180s in level and the game really either forces you to wait for those Daily Bonus of coins or pay to play. I don't want to say it's a cash grab but it feels so much like it. EDIT: Also, Devs don't really listen. They say they do, but considering the date of the reviews that say the same thing? Doubtful.

Fun, but costly. What more could a classic Disney fan (before they went off the deep end) ask for. You get to play cards to unlock themed backgrounds from beloved Disney movies. However, that enjoyment quickly fades away once the player realizes that each level costs coins to play, the cost for 'power ups' increases substantially (right from the start, too), and the constant reminders of purchasing packages, the game just becomes another cash grab. Coins for power-ups are fine, but not levels.

Good time sink, but every time you open the app you get confronted with 3-4 different screens of "offers" to buy in-game currency and rewards. Of course it's completely optional to purchase these, but you can tell the game's primary purpose is to suck cash from you. Not every level is winnable first time, due to the "random" nature, but it has that claw machine brand of randomness where it feels like the game has decided you can't win this one so try again in an hour or pay more money.
I'm enjoying it I think it's a great game. Not only you're playing Solitaire but you also get a chance to decorate the room dance put statues and items on the wall it's ongoing fun.

Shocking!! Absolute cash grab and pay to win!! Level 1 to 30 let's you earn around 30,000 coins with ease but from level 40 onwards, the game strategically makes you lose and you have to use all your coins to pass a level. Forcing you into a position where the only way you can progress is either wait a ridiculously long time or spend real money. I expected so much better from Disney, but just like any other game here, it's all about the money and less about user enjoyment. DO BETTER!!

good game. I was enjoying it. Once you start hitting level 70+ you don't get enough coins to even attempt another level. so you end up waiting 2 hours for one turn that will probably fail. it's a strange system that DOES NOT WORK. most apps of this type have 5 lives that refresh over time giving you more than 1 attempt on a level. this app needs to adapt this method. so just the 2 stars from me as it's simply unplayable (Unless you purchase coins).

I made a review but it was lacking detail. this game is really fun, but it's pay to win. you start off with a decent amount of coins and you have to spend coins to play a level, to buy more decks of cards, to undo a move and to buy the magic cards. The cost of extra decks are ridiculous and not worth it. 5 times out of 10 the 5 cards you get in that extra deck are useless and you just wasted 4k for nothing and can't retry the round because you spent all your coins. Just greedy developers.

I have to echo these other reviews. As a Disney fan, I was so excited for this game, and it was actually fun at first. The themes are great. The obvious money grabs just turned me off. The game becomes impossible to play once you reach the Toy Story level, unless you're willing to pay (which, seeing how the cards are ridiculously stacked against you, is not tempting as I know my money will not go far). Fix your game and fix it quickly, because I can guarantee it will flop very soon if you don't.

its very fun and addictive. however, the amount of pop ups each and every time I open the app, the time it takes to go through each 'reward' pop up, how rigged winning a game after the first few levels are, the amount of coins it takes to play 1 level. it makes the game not worth it. its frustrating and such a ploy to make you spend money (I dont have) very disappointing considering Disney definitely doesnt need it lol

This game is a cash grab. Lures you in with quirky graphics and the first few levels are genuinely quite fun for a pocket game. Quite soon it becomes clear that you MUST spend real money to advance. The rewards are paltry and it very quickly costs more coins to complete a level than you earn in rewards for completing it. The fact that the cost to play a level and the cost of using items scales up all the time through the levels means you're never building coins but slowly/quickly depleting them.

the game is very well made, no ads at all, however it's a very obvious money grab. it definitely looks rigged to make you lose so that you buy more coins in order to just try the level again. when you get free power ups like wildcards or extra cards, for sure they will be gone by the end of the level. i really want to like the game, and invest in it but it has to be more balanced.

this game could be so much fun if it didnt require to use money. in your responses you say "payments are optional". well, yes. but the game is purposefully made to be hard, you barely get any coins to play levels and the coins that you win per level barely get you anywhere. the game is well done, i love the design and animations, the music etc and the levels are fun. but its very obviously a cashgrab which is pretty sad..

loving the game, and the scene contents. not really a true solitaire, more like a dominoes style game with cards, but it's cute and has a few different aspects for challenges. one thing I would say the developers could consider, would be to have the ability to match a card with another, e.g. you draw an ace and there is one on the board so you can put one ace on top of another. perhaps it could be something you could win or gain as another option, like the rewind option.

This was a great game at the start, but I'm now around level 91 and even though everything is costing more game coins, the coins you gain per level don't make up for how much it costs to play a level, let alone pay for any bonusses. This is making it impossible to finish levels without paying actual money. Finishing events is completely impossible. Since it's a fairly new game, I'm giving it to the next update. But depending on the hourly bonuses to be able to play isn't great gameplay.

Disney should be ashamed of this. Pure gambling game. Every single thing is made to push you to pay more to keep going, even though you barely have any control over the outcome of the game. At the end it always comes down to be lucky and get the few rights cards. It's not a puzzle where it is puzzle to finish it every time. Edit: They answered saying buying is optional. I'm not arguing it is not, I'm arguing it is luvk based, so it is gambling, not a skill game.

The game graphics is superb, the scenes are adorable, but the game is a money stealer. I managed to get past level 50(completed first 2 scenes) without buying anything. now it's harder and harder to progress. every level costs game money to play, and if you win, you get only a 10-15% more than the cost of playing that level. So you are left with no money very soon. 10/10 for graphics, 3/10 for gameplay and costs balance. I probably uninstall after I will get frustrated because of slow progress

It was cool and fun until it wasn't. I can see that most people feel the same and hopefully the developers will consider making changes. It's frustrating to need so many coins to play then get to the last card and have to end the round, wait for one hour to be able to play again for just one or two rounds. all the other "side" games or challenges aren't helpful, and cause stress. and the card collection does not have any purpose. you get "rewards" when you finish a set but it takes forever.

This game is alright It's fun to play but it does get repetitive sometimes. there isn't much of a challenge for example every 5 levels 4 of them will be easy to complete making the 5 really difficult not challenging, difficult this can be annoying when you run out of coins leaving you wait until you get more or forced to buy coins if you are a paid to play player. the events are cool and I like the stickers you can unlock.

Updating to 1 star. It may be optional to buy coins but you devs make it so it feels like you have to if you want to play this game. Lvls seem rigged. Pay to Play 200% So.. I really want to give this game a good review, but yikes... the amount of coins you need to play this is ridiculous, and it just gets higher to the point you can't play till you get the daily coins option... especially when you lose a lot... getting helps in the game is near impossible with the amount of coins it costs.
seems like you really have to spend to play with sucks because it's a fun game makes people lose interest 🙄

really fun game just wish it actually gave you things you need. Just went through the Easter egg painting got 4 of 5 colors in a day, the other 4days I couldn't get the 5th color to save my LIFE!! Don't make stuff unwinable.

BEWARE. This game is very fun and addictive, but it is almost impossible to achieve challenges without spending money. I have experienced multiple occasions where rewards were not given as advertised, the most recent being a x2 bonus on a grand prize (over 3M coins). Customer support will only ever give you a small gift for an error. They recently launched a Facebook community where I tried to share my experience and it was deleted. They don't want people to know the truth.
pretty good solitaire game with little to no ads unless you want them.

This is a scam.. you do not "play" this version of solitare. you simply watch and see ifvit let's it complete.. card movements do not change the outcome of the game.. it simply clears or it does not.. then asks for moneyvto clear the level.. it basically extort you into paying to clear a level.. you can't get past level 4 without paying real world money.. it's a scam..

This game is fun and I have willingly spent over $200 on it so far. Last night, I made a purchase but there was a bug and I did not receive the gold/items in my purchase. I sent in a message to Support who promptly replied and gave me "compensation" but that still did not consist of my purchased gold/items. They have been extremely slow in replying since. It's been almost 24 hours since the purchase, and the support person (Erik) has insisted I have received it when I haven't. Shame on them.

NINE times (on average)I have to close the pop up windows before I can play one game. Nine! All the other reviews are correct in that you start with a lot of coins until it becomes impossible to complete the rounds therefore have to spend money to play more. it is rigged! too bad when the game could be entertaining. Max playing time is around 5 min.

Biggest money grab game I've ever played and I would advise people not to install it. Starts off great but then when you reach a certain level they make it impossible to win without spending money. Takes way too long to finish a scene as they only give 1 star no matter what level you play,,,wild cards cost a ridiculous amount of coins. It could be an amazing game if they where fair but as always they only think about the money

Despite the nice graphics it is one of the most rigged games. Not only that but the game is so aggressive in advertising numerous ways to pay in order to play that you easily feel harassed! Now, I reach the level of the game that when I fail you cannot play anymore unless you paid. Previously, you could wait one hour and get a bonus to try again.

Visually impressive with top-tier animation, characters, and audio. However, the constant barrage of monetisation prompts—sometimes up to seven in a row—quickly diminishes the experience. The need to check in hourly just to earn enough coins for brief gameplay becomes frustrating. What prompted this review, though, was the recent change making stickers time-limited—an update that feels both misleading and unfair.

I started out really enjoying this game, loved earning stars to build up the Disney scenes. I purchased a couple of packs with real money and starting winning the majority of the games but as soon as I stopped paying, I noticed I was losing all of the time and was no longer progressing. the Winnie the pooh competition is impossible to complete because when you get near the top, no matter what you pretty much lose. it is such a shame that this game is only playable when you pay money.

I like the concept of it, but having to spend coins instead of lives/hearts is definitely a choice and not a good one. You get coins every hour but for that you have to open the app, in other games you get a heart back every 30mins which is so much better. And how much you have to spend on a level increases, which makes it even more awful. I just started today but I already uninstall for that alone.

I must say, could be an awesome as game.. but the amount of times you lose is dumb. All levels should be solvable, but clearly are not. When repeating a level it should always be the same shuffle/deal of cards. Instead it's a completely different deal and you're bound to lose again and again until you finally come across one that is solvable. When you're dealt the same hand you can at least play it a different way till you win. But the game is clearly set up to be a money grab.

This is a good game idea, but it takes a stupid amount of levels to finish each scenes. I am on level 350 and not even finished scene 8. The amount of stars for each scene needs to be revised and lowered a lot to make this more fun. Also it costs a ridiculous amount of coins to ppay each level. Yes you get the amount for a level once per hour but it makes this unplayable for extended periods of time and is not enjoyable.

Great until you get to higher levels... im now on 84 but this game has no longevity unless you're willing to spend real money. The fee to play each level and then fee of required wild cards and boosters massively outweigh the actual rewards. It's very unbalanced, and the incentive isn't enough to keep you wanting to come back and play because it just becomes painful and disappointing. I hope you can take advice from some other games that work well and improve to keep players around.

This was fun at first but with the coin to play system, you basically get to play once and if you fail then you close it and forget about it. You have to set an alarm every hour to remind you to go in and collect coins so you can play more than once (not doing that). I am over level 150 and it costs so much to play, that one win almost doesn't even cover the next play. They really just want you to purchase coins to play but it's worse because you have to spend the coins every time.

This game would be great but its just unplayable. While you can collect coins every hour it isn't enough to play one level. Daily coins are ok and you can have about 10 minutes in the game when you first log in, however they are not consistent with how many they give, one day i could get 9000 the next 19000. Unless you remember to log in every hour and save the coins up then you just can't play unless you spend real money. Such a shame because it would be a great game otherwise.

it's extremely irritating how many coins you have to spend to play a level and if you keep losing you lose massive amounts of your coins. Once you get up there, there's way too many levels that are difficult to beat and if you can't then all your hard earned coins are gone 🤷🏼‍♀️ and it's absolutely ridiculous the amount of coins you have to spend to get an extra deck at the end or a wild card. Disney sucks in every aspect! Do better!

excellent game visually and the idea behind it but it's a massive cash grab! there is not enough gold income at all to keep playing unless you spend cash on the game! The events are even worse... because there is no guarantee to win each level you play... it's all about luck of the draw and if you get no luck, you cannot progress them.

Pay coin for every level try doesn't seems right. Trying to win with help also pay coin. After some level, the coin always decreased after completing a level. Ended up with me running out of coin, and can't play anymore. Maybe, better with energy system, and the coin just for the help inside the game, or give some other way to earn coin besides waiting for 1 hour for 1 try. Besides, the game is also based on luck, so it's imposible to always win the game on any level.

The amount of real money you are trying to get from people is shocking. It might seem optional to spend real money, but without spending real money you'll basically be unable to play much. You can play like 1 game every couple of hours, run out of coins then bring up tons of ways to use real cash to get coins to play. There needs to be a balance, but this way is not fun. It should be labeled as a gambling app and regulated.

Game play is actually good and addictive. The problem is that this game is basically gambling. You have to pay coins to play a game, but as it's all luck based, if you get a bad streak then that match becomes unwinnable and you have to spend more coins or give up the coins you spent to play and forfeit. You get free coins every hour but only enough for one game. Events can also pay out coins, but unless you have enough to play with, then it's useless.

Could be a great game, but boy, are they greedy. You get one game every hour for free via bonus coins you can collect. Every game won gives you a bonus between 250 and 500 coins, but it costs 2300 (for me at this point) to play one round. Boosts in the game (like +5 cards) cost i.e. 4000 coins. Don't even try throwing your money at the game, you'll end up broke... 4 dollars give you 5 rounds to play in coins that's just ridiculous. Uninstalling now

it's a fun game, but it's very addictive and almost impossible to play without spending money. every hour, you receive enough coins to play once, and the levels are getting more and more difficult which is frustrating bc you have to wait another hour just to try again the daily events are cute, though, with lots of prizes for me, this addiction became an issue, and I seriously think I should stop

I love Disney, but this game quickly turned into a massive dissapointment. I am level 89 and can barely afford to keep playing as the cost of playing far outweighs the rewards for completing levels. I HAVE spent money in this game as I like progressing and puzzle games. But enough is enough. It becomes a pure cash grab past level 50. It cost 2x more than the level for a wildcard, sometimes 3x 4x more for extra cards. Not to mention the reminder to buy coins after each level or game start. Unsub.

I really enjoyed this game to begin with but it was clear to see that once you have got used to the levels, they purposely make you lose so you spend your real money just to play a level. I have stupidly done this and managed to play around 3 levels before you have to spend again. This is just a money making game, which is so disappointing because it has so much potential.

When I first downloaded this game it was great. I had loads of coins so could easily progress but the further I got the more I noticed you had to use coins to open and play levels. Never seen a game do this before meaning if you have to replay a level a few times to win it costs a lot of coins meaning you run out very quickly. I don't see the logic in paying to play levels. Paying to get assistance in levels if your stuck possibly just not to open levels. Ruined the game for me.

It's not bad, I'm on lvl 400+ (0$ spend, I'm f2p) but overall it's boring. You pass levels and do tasks, that's it. There is no interaction with characters, you cannot choose what scene to display - f.e I want to have an option to choose finished scenes and see them instead of scene for which i have tasks. And also to have an album with finished puzzles. Also add option to change nickname. I will not delete game, but will wait for next updates - mb devs will give more interesting content.

I completely agree with the other reviews. I love the game but it is sadly rigged for in app purchase. The hourly coins are not enough to keep the game playing especially as in some levels you have to use coins to complete the game. It is sad as its a really enjoyable solitare format and the graphics are great! Its just whether you are happy to constantly be funneling money into a game, which sadly I am not.

the game itself is cute, although not too much different than other similar games. that being said, it's very similar to other games where it becomes almost impossible to pass levels after a while, you start running out of coins, you need to spend money to keep on playing or you get enough bonus coins to play one game every 2 hours.

It's a cute little game. And it could earn 5 stars if the coins count was correct, but it's not. Every time one wants to play has to pay 2000 coins for the attempt to pass the lvl. (why?) And the amount of coins required for 5+ cards is insane. Not sure why I should pay double the price if the game is giving me 5 or more cards not useful to finish the lvl. Give us lives or something, or make us earn more coins for the completion of the lvl.

This app is so frustrating it's basically unplayable! The economy of the game is the most ridiculous I've ever seen, the in game boosts cost 2-3x as much as it costs to start a game, and the rewards are so low you can hardly play. When you are playing it feels rigged against you, sometimes I have one card left on my board and I click through TEN OR MORE cards in the deck and still don't have a playable one. I get that you want to make money, but this game is a sadistic capitalist nightmare.

Starting out this game seems fair and strategic but as you progress you will come to realise there's no strategy at all except to force you to buy coins to play. The graphics are nice and the game play is faultless however it doesn't take long to realise this is not luck of the cards as solitaire should be and in some instances it's obvious extortion to pass a level. By level 150 you will see exactly how this game is blatantly geared to force you to spend.

I'm currently on level 283 and what do you mean it now costs 10,000 coins to play!? You have to play the Epic Level to be able to get by in the game and get the rewards otherwise its takes way too long on the Standard Level. Yes, I've spent on the game to play cause it's a good game. But.... Now it's coming to the point where after I've spent these coins I might as well cut my loses and uninstall the game because it's going to end up costing more than it's worth 😑

So sad after the daily 4th in-a-row game you start losing options to play... yes losing while playing correctly in the free version at least. Good looking though but an excessive amount of sound and visual effects in-between each game that don't bring any more value to it. This well-known franchise might surely have others games that simply let you play more time per day. In conclusion, the payment option might let play more than 10 min per day (free version) since the content is quite limited.

Initially I was really enjoying this game but as you progress it goes from being fun to being downright frustrating. Whilst there is some shred of skill involved, this game is purely luck based and rigged against you. it requires more and more coins to progress, always encouraging you to spend actual money for in-game currency! I wish I could continue with this game but its just became so infuriating and no longer any fun. Good concept, greedily poor execution! What a shame!

The game was really nice and addictive but the more you advance the more it becomes impossible to play without buying coins and the coins are just not enough. I am in level 311 and even with 110000 is practically impossible to win. The game is practically useless at this point. Are you making new levels for millionaires? or is this your idea for interesting? There are many other solitaire that at least give you an option to earn your coins not buy your wins. I am not buying anymore packages.

Enjoying the game so far, especially in it's early stages. feel like there should be more way to earn more coins or reduced prices for the abilities. some sort of team option might be fun to interact with friends abit more. I have invited atleast 2 friends using the link share and only received 1. I have now hit a point where I can only attempt a level once per hour which is making me lose interest and my opinion on the game is quickly deteriorating.

Starts off fun, but gets increasingly impossible after around level 70. You can claim coins once an hour but these are only enough for one game at 1x rewards, and each level will take multiple attempts to beat because the cards are so unfair. Most of the time you have no chance to beat a level at all with the cards you're given. Wildcards and extra cards are outrageously expensive too so you can never use them. This is a blatant cash grab disguised as a cutesy Disney game.

Good game but progression is unfair. Either keep the cost of undo, extra cards and wild card at lower coin values, or remove the coin cost of initiating a level attempt. Coins are used for everything and you don't get enough of them later in the game to make any progress unless you get extremely lucky. If you want people to play and spend money you need to make it possible to continue playing F2P normally. Right now you're going to have a lot of people dropping off around level 90 or so.

pretty good game but very much rigged to make you spend money, what do you expect being Disney right? will keep feeding you cards to make you feel like your progressing then you will have days of only going up a few levels and getting no wins with constant nagging to buy bundles that are on "special". currently lv. 166+ so I've had more then enough gametime for my review.

a disaster just like the snow white movie. this game forces you to pay real money. you can't beat two levels in a row without losing. each time you want to play a level (even if it's a replay) you should spend gold and they give you gold needed to play it every one hour! it means you can play just once every one hour! and all the power ups need gold! sometimes you get to the final card on the field with 10 cards in your hand and the game doesn't give you the card you need. so you have to buy! 😡

So disappointed! I honestly thought this would be a fun little game... and then I saw all my coins disappearing at an insane rate. I barely made it to the 3rd scene before my entire game came grinding to halt. Ridiculous coin pricing, impossible to earn it back even when you win. I have to age with others , this game is sadly a massive cash grab. Save yourself money and disappointment, find a better app. :(

I enjoy playing the game because the cut scenes are fun to unlock. The only problem I have with it is that the higher the level, the more coins you need to play it. I think the coins should be set the same for all levels. This is because the scenes at higher levels already require a lot more levels to get through. Having both a coin increase and more levels to pass makes it too challenging. It should be one or the other(preferably more levels to pass to unlock a scene at the higher levels)

Game tweaks the solitaire mechanism enough to be enjoyable. Continuous play would get expensive because each level of progress sees the cost to play ramp up. This took the shine off it for me and I didn't enjoy playing enough to buy into the usual in-app-purchase mechanisms, leaving me cynical about true randomness vs. motivation to generate revenue.
Fun and easy levels, no annoying ads.

great game at first but you cant earn enough coins to cope with the amount of re tries you need for most levels, money runs out just trying to get past 1 level and the opportunities to win coins aren't worth much coins

This game is the very definition of predatory. Tinkerbell getting mad at me for not spending more coins for power ups to MAYBE complete the level is a nice touch. Disney should really pull the licensing from this one. Bad look for Tink. As soon as you run out of coins, delete.
It is captivating. The game will catch you attention quickly at the begining amd will not let go. A different approach for a solitaire game. It is worth a try

I liked it at first. But as you progress you lose more than you win. So you reach a point when you run out of money and can't play anymore. And believe me, I tried. I played it 3 times from the begining, tried different strategies. Always the same result. Couldn't get pass Snow White each time. And the hourly bonus is not enough for one game. So if you wait a few hours and get to play again, you lose...again. Not everyone can afford to pay for a game. So that's it for me...uninstall for good.

This game is definitely rigged lol it will purposefully give you cards you don't need, make you use up your coins and then you would have to wait a day or two before you can actually sit down for a good hour or two to play and enjoy the game. Not worth, better game out there

while the game is fun and super cute the cost to play is absolutely insane. like why does the cost to play a level increase so dramatically? like if you dont want us to play it for long then just say that smh
i love it...finally a game with no commercials!
Overall fun game! Challenging with lots of added features. Pay to play optional. Solitaire evolved for older kids and adults who enjoy Disney themed material. Recommend parental supervision.

I like this app. Unlike the other apps you earn actual money. Only issue that i have with it is that you play for pennies, yet they advertise this like a person can pay bills with this app. I won't believe that until it happens.

First impression was giving 2 stars due to the Disney scenes and feeling the challenges would be too easy and somewhat boring. I really enjoyed the levels and surprisingly looked forward to completing the disney scenes.

its cute,its easy enough to help kids learn the game but challenging enough to keep adults playing.I love that your playing one of the the old school games while seeing the magic of Disney movies.It would be nea5 r if they talked as well, or said a movie quote.
I enjoyed the graphics, it was like I was in movie. Very fun 😁.

This game somehow "encourages" you to use real money to keep playing. At level 150, you need 2,300 coins to start the round. When you complete the round, you'll get around 2,500 - 2,700 on average. The help cost 5,500 for the wild card and around 4,500 for the first +1, and it gets more expensive (almost double i think) for the 2nd and so on. You'll get around 2,200 bonus coins each hour. Just do the math. I'm not opening the game every hour to collect the bonus just to keep playing.

Encourages you to spend money. No ads. Rewards after winning every round is not enough. When you reach level 90+, you will always use a Wild Card so will be force to spend money. Bonus coins does not stack so you have to be online to collect 1 hour bonus. This game is a bait. I love disney but this is all about money. It was fun while it lasted.
Wow such a fun game everyone should get it just for the Disney scenes

the games aesthetics are relatively inoffensive and achieve what they're aiming for. the puzzle dynamics are fun when you can actually succeed. however, this game has an insane amount of events or limited time things that pop up every single time you open the app. and you almost never win. the whole point is to just suck money out of your wallet, and it's not very secretive about it. it's very in your face. I'd recommend buy a pack of cards and playing solitaire irl instead of paying for this
it's a bit confusing at times. otherwise is great. Actually I'll go back on that. I've paid for upgrade? Not got it. very annoyed and unintalled. £4 down the drain. Sick of these scams

garbage! I was between level 63-66 and spent almost $20 dollars working towards an Amazon gift card from Flash Rewards. But when I logged in to the app today I was. back at level 6 somehow??? I'm done 😠
I love solitare,love the games graphics and music.This set my tone for the day.ty!
don't need real monies to play. no ads you don't want. a bit of patience when you get stuck. altogether a pretty decent game for someone who needs extra help focusing while doing something else.

Undoing actions should NOT cost you anything at the very least.

I want to love this game but it's clearly designed with the SINGLE intention to make you spend real money. The card draws are obviously rigged to ensure you do not win more than 1 game out of 10 without needing to purchase a game aid. Each level requires you to pay from your coin collection which gets smaller and smaller since the costs for everything in the game increases. Graphics are beautiful, its too bad this is an obvious scam.
